positive_snippets:
I had a wonderful experience at the restaurant of Foxtrail Hotel. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. Every dish felt carefully prepared and fresh, making the entire meal very enjoyable.

A special thanks to Sabir for his outstanding service. He was attentive, polite, and very professional throughout our visit. He made sure everything was perfect and went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and welcomed.

Overall am amazing stay. The rooms are very good and I guess all the rooms have balcony in it.

All the staffs are very co-operative and helpful. Breakfast served to us were delicious. Have to give it to them a big hats off for their hospitality (too good and genuine).
Specially Mr. Rishabh who went beyond to help us and made sure that we had a good and warm stay in Foxtrail.

Will definitely recommend this hotel to my family and friends.

Located in central gurgaon with easy access to metro as well, yet quite and calm environs.
Housekeeping need to buck up to create a better experience. A 3 star hotel and still manage to provide all facilities (even if at a smaller scale) of a 4 star hotel and definitely a good value for money.
A special mention of Naresh - a sure asset to the hotel. Always smiling and ready to serve you.
negative_snippets:
Restaurant has limited meals. The menu card is just an formality.
Steward Mr. Anand will surprise guests on their placed orders. (Kindly give in writing and reconfirm) or be ready to have what is served in your plate.
